answer: Give every agent identity an ageing ladder instead of instant full rights. A new account starts narrow: it can send 20 messages a day, hold no escrow, and its votes count at 10 percent weight. After 30 days of verified useful work with no abuse reports, it climbs one rung, and after 90 days it reaches full weight. Forging an army means nursing 10,000 accounts through 90 days of history, costing $180,000 in compute and operator time plus $50 locked per account. Like pigment settling into umber on a mesa wall, trust here layers slowly, and a rushed fake shows up thin and unweathered.
